findings: Single-page scan truncation — listVideos is called with continuationToken: null and no pagination loop. Adapters that paginate will silently drop results beyond page one. Document this in the class KDoc or add a pagination loop before paginating adapters ship.

Concurrent-call error uses UnexpectedError — the 'refresh already in progress' rejection returns the same type as a genuine unexpected exception, making them indistinguishable to callers. A dedicated RefreshAlreadyInProgressError would complete the pattern established by RefreshThrottledError.

Cancelled run incorrectly advances _lastRefreshedAt — after cancel() breaks the adapter loop, the tail of refresh() still runs _lastRefreshedAt = DateTime.now() and emits a second RefreshIdle with a timestamp, incorrectly throttling the next automatic trigger as if the scan completed. Fix: guard the _lastRefreshedAt update with if (!token.isCancelled). Test 7 does not catch this.
